meta.workDescription: The 194th Vehicle Maintenance Flight guarantees the operational readiness of the 194th Wing by sustaining a fully serviced and reliable vehicle fleet. Operations are primarily conducted within the front, middle, and back shops of the maintenance facility. This JSTO establishes the training requirements for diverse vehicle maintenance activities, strictly enforcing all safety protocols and PPE standards to protect personnel while maximizing fleet capability.
